---
name: A device or a release format this does not handle
about: Ask before writing code, so the manifest schema stays one schema
labels: ''
---

**The device or the format.** What it is, and what the page does today.

**What the files look like.** Which binaries your build produces, and the address
each one goes to.

**Why the existing manifest cannot say it.** The fields are listed in
[docs/manifest.md](../docs/manifest.md); say which one is missing or wrong rather
than which code should change.
